item.title: Hospitality Careers: Life and Logistics in Yellowstone National Park - Wyoming Office of Tourism Industry Partners
item.description: Amazon News recently published a video to their YouTube channel featuring the iconic Yellowstone National Park and how its residents and visitors continue to receive packages in the winter – even in the toughest of conditions. Despite inclement weather and wildlife creating obstacles along the two-hour trek from the warehouse to Old Faithful Snow Lodge, Amazon delivery driver Ben Mitchem doesn’t let these stop him from delivering valuable packages to the park.

item.title: Wyoming Outdoor Recreation Summit - Wyoming Office of Tourism Industry Partners
item.description: Highlights from the first day include a keynote address from the Outdoor Recreation Roundtable and the reveal of the 2024-2028 State Comprehensive Outdoor Recreation Plan for Wyoming. The first day will culminate with a happy hour and a poster session with University of Wyoming students to present their capstone work.

item.title: Spring Visitors Services FAM trip - Wyoming Office of Tourism Industry Partners
item.description: Send your frontline staff from your Welcome/Visitors Center to discover a place where history, culture and natural beauty intertwine to create an immersive experience like no other. Provide them an opportunity to network and connection with fellows adventures along the way, sharing stories and forging new friendships while expanding their of areas and tourism products around the state of Wyoming.

item.description: Amy Larsen, Industry Relations Manager, recently sat down with Travel Preneur, the weekly business show for the travel industry to discuss the Wyoming Office of Tourisms strategies in promoting Wyoming as a vacation destination, highlighting the state’s unique attractions, cultural experiences, and natural wonders. https://youtu.be/oFee_vx-a6Y You can find the full podcast here.

item.title: Diane Shober Awarded 2025 State Tourism Director of the Year
item.description: Diane Shober, executive director for the Wyoming Office of Tourism, was announced August 18th as the 2025 State Tourism Director of the Year by her industry peers.

item.title: The Ultimate Fall Escape: Wyoming Awaits
item.description: Venture beyond the crowded destinations this fall and discover a different side of the season in Wyoming, where breathtaking scenery meets authentic Western culture. Imagine vibrant aspen trees set against a backdrop of the jagged peaks of the Wind River Range. Ride horseback in the crisp autumn air through sagebrush-covered landscapes at a historic dude ranch like Triangle X Ranch. Here, the fall season offers a chance to connect with nature and history on another level.

item.title: Governor Gordon Announces Leadership Transition at Wyoming Office of Tourism
item.description: Governor Gordon announces the appointment of Domenic Bravo as the new Executive Director of the Wyoming Office of Tourism, succeeding long-serving Director Diane Shober, who will retire after more than two decades of distinguished service.

item.title: Wyoming Office of Tourism Partners with Mindtrip to Help Visitors Plan Their Perfect Adventure
item.description: Mindtrip, an AI-powered platform that empowers everyone to travel differently, today announced it has partnered with the Wyoming Office of Tourism (WOT) to transform the destination’s inspirational website content into personalized and actionable trip plans.

item.title: Get Ready for an Authentic Wyoming Winter: Explore Snow-Capped National Parks and Beyond
item.description: Wyoming invites visitors on a snowy, adventure-filled escape this winter. Discover wide-open spaces, picture-perfect landscapes, iconic national parks and authentic Western charm with a touch of holiday spirit.
